default_gui_native_wheel_scroll.reason: Current CCB/rmux/tmux policy enables mouse on, so ordinary pane wheel events enter application mouse reporting rather than WezTerm's default terminal scroll path.

negative_binding_assertion.reason: Absence of WheelUpPane, WheelDownPane, scroll-up, or scroll-down bindings is necessary regression protection but does not prove foreground wheel scrolling is visible.

tmux_rmux_copy_mode_scroll.reason: Copy-mode scroll may be a valid alternative but changes the interaction contract from WezTerm GUI-native scroll to tmux/rmux-like scrollback behavior.

mouse_off_or_modifier_bypass.reason: Host terminal native scroll requires an explicit mouse reporting off or modifier-bypass route and fresh foreground validation; no such route is selected in this goal.

pane_app_wheel_passthrough.reason: Pane app wheel passthrough depends on the running app and cannot be claimed as generic ordinary pane terminal scrollback.

unsupported_capability.reason: No approved default wheel scroll route exists under current mouse on policy; runtime behavior remains unchanged.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: claim_no_scroll_binding_as_native_pass
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: This only proves a command was not bound; it does not observe visible foreground scroll.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: copy_mode_scroll_as_gui_native
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: Copy-mode scroll may be a valid separate feature strategy, but not a GUI-native parity pass.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: pane_app_passthrough_as_terminal_scrollback
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: An app-specific wheel route does not prove generic terminal scrollback behavior.
